Vivekanand @ Vivek vs State Of U.P And Another on 23 March,
2023
Author: Vipin Chandra Dixit

Bench: Vipin Chandra Dixit
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Court No. - 69
Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 39459 of 2022
Applicant :- Vivekanand @ Vivek

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Opposite Party :- State Of U.P And Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Rajesh Kumar Tiwari Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Jagdish Prasad Mishra Hon'ble Vipin Chandra Dixit,J.

Heard Sri Rajesh Kumar Tiwari, learned counsel for applicant, Sri Jagdish Prasad Mishra, learned counsel for opposite party no.2 and learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.
It is submitted by learned counsel for the applicant that the parties have amicably settled their dispute outside the Court and a written compromise had taken place on 1.4.2022.
Photocopy of the compromise deed is annexed as annexure 6 to the affidavit filed in support of the application.
It is stated in the compromise which had taken place on 1.4.2022 that the marriage was solemnized five years back and since then, applicant and opposite party no.2 are living as husband and wife.

It is further submitted that since marriage was solemnized between the parties and they are residing together as husband and wife and opposite party no.2 does not want to prosecute the applicant,
present proceeding may be quashed.

entities.text: Vivekanand @ Vivek vs State Of U.P And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 1 Learned A.G.A. for the State as well as learned counsel for opposite party No.2 do not dispute the aforesaid facts.

In view of the aforesaid fact, since the parties have amicably settled their dispute and are residing together as husband and wife and the opposite party No.2 does not want to prosecute the applicant in the present case, the proceeding against the applicant is liable to be quashed.

Accordingly, the present Application U/S 482 Cr.P.C. is allowed and the charge sheet No.180 of 2019 dated 29.9.2019, cognizance/summoning order dated 21.1.2020 as well as entire proceedings of Session Trial No. 132 of 2020(State vs. Vivekanand @ Vivek) under Sections 376, 377, 452, 504,
506 IPC and 67 of Information Technology Act, Police Station Husainganj, District Fatehpur,
pending in the court of Additional Session Judge/ Fast Track Court No.1, Fatehpur, are hereby quashed.
